Submit Birth Notification From Health Fa.description: Creates a v2 birth event and notifies it in one step, e.g. when a hospital EMR records a delivery.

Create Event.description: Creates an empty v2 birth or death event; its id is returned on state.data.id.

Notify Event.description: Sends declaration data for an event created in an earlier step.

Send FHIR Birth Notification Bundle.description: Submits a legacy (v1) FHIR document bundle to the gateway's notification endpoint.

Search Registered Births.description: Searches registered birth records in a date range, e.g. to sync new births to a civil ID or social-protection registry.

Search Deaths By Location.description: Finds death records registered at one location, e.g. for mortality reporting to DHIS2.

Get Locations.description: Fetches the country's admin areas and facilities, e.g. to map facility codes to OpenCRVS location ids.
